Thank you.
It was a combination of things.
I mean, first of all, I didn't believe that I won,
and then I saw my box, and they all kind of celebrated.
And that's when I realized that I won, especially seeing
my father raise up his arms.
That was when it kind of hit me that, OK, I won.

all the emotions came out because, again,

but it's also special in a very positive way

No, no, no.
I was just very tight today.

feel like the match was a lot more up and down, so I think the level was not as
stable as the previous matches for me. And I was a lot more nervous, which at
some stage is also human, I think. But yeah, that's why I say the cramps helped
me in a way because my mind let go. I started swinging more freely, I started hitting the
